reuse.why: Puts the check in the existing accounts/link.ts helper module next to findOrCreateBank and applies it to the five existing link handlers through one wrapper instead of editing each copy.

duplication.why: The holder query and error exist once; the five registrations differ only in provider name and account-id accessor.

placement.why: The rule sits in link.ts, the tree's linking helper module; the wrapper is defined inline among the app.method registrations, slightly unusual but local to where handlers are wired.

scope.why: Only the rule, its wiring and tests.

maintainability.why: One definition with a clear wrapper; a new provider handler must be registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked, which is visible at the registration site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers are registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked, which calls link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

one_place.where: accounts/link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, applied to gocardless/simplefin/pluggyai/akahu/enablebanking link requests through refuseIfAlreadyLinked in accounts/app.ts.
